skill_name: What are four approaches to combatting climate change?
workflow: Four approaches to combatting climate change include reducing greenhouse gas emissions, adapting to the changes caused by climate change, investing in renewable energy sources, and conserving and restoring ecosystems. Reducing greenhouse gas emissions can involve implementing energy efficiency measures, transitioning to renewable energy sources, changing lifestyles and diets, and improving public transportation.
